summary: Phase 3 comprehensive testing completed for CareHome Clocking System. All backend APIs (25/25 tests) and frontend features working correctly. Demo login flows, Staff Profile with all tabs, Manager Dashboard with approval workflows, notifications, messages, monthly calendar, team calendar all functional.

issues: 60-second idle timeout is quite short for testing - may auto-logout during slower interactions

backend_api: POST /api/auth/validate-pin with correct PIN 1234 - returns token
GET /api/notifications - returns notifications list with unread count
GET /api/calendar/monthly-rota - returns shifts and leave data
GET /api/staff/profile - returns comprehensive profile with leave balance
GET /api/staff/colleagues - returns colleagues list for swap targeting
GET /api/shift-swaps (staff) - returns own swaps, available swaps, direct requests
frontend_flows: Demo login flow: Staff button -> PIN 1234 -> redirects to /staff
Demo login flow: Manager button -> PIN 1234 -> redirects to /manager
Staff Profile: Overview tab shows user info, leave balance (28/28 days), upcoming shifts (12), pending requests (4), quick actions
Staff Profile: My Rota tab shows MonthlyCalendar with color-coded shifts (Early=yellow, Late=blue, Night=purple)
Staff Profile: Shift Swaps tab shows Available Swaps from Colleagues and My Swap Requests sections
Staff Profile: Annual Leave tab shows 28 total entitlement, 0 used, 28 remaining with leave requests table
Staff Profile: Team Calendar tab shows TeamCalendar component with team availability
Staff Profile: Day Requests tab shows day on/off requests with New Request button
Staff Profile: Messages button opens MessagesInbox modal with Inbox/Sent tabs and Compose
Staff Profile: NotificationBell component renders in header with unread count badge
Manager Dashboard: Dashboard tab shows stats cards (Total Staff: 18, Clocked In, Not Arrived, On Leave)
Manager Dashboard: Pending approvals alert shows 4 pending (2 leave, 2 day requests)
Manager Dashboard: Approvals tab shows Leave Requests, Day Requests, Shift Swaps with Approve/Reject buttons
Manager Dashboard: Shift Swaps tab shows Swaps Pending Your Approval section
Manager Dashboard: Messages button in header present
Manager Dashboard: NotificationBell component with badge (2 notifications)

seed_data_creation: Database seeded via POST /api/seed (18 employees) and POST /api/seed-shifts (144 shifts created for testing)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 features fully tested. All demo login flows work. Staff Profile has 6 working tabs (Overview, My Rota, Shift Swaps, Annual Leave, Team Calendar, Day Requests). Manager Dashboard has approval workflows for leave requests, day requests, and shift swaps. MonthlyCalendar shows color-coded shifts. TeamCalendar shows team availability. NotificationBell and MessagesInbox modals functional. Data is seeded - 18 employees with 144 shifts. Note: 60-second idle timeout may auto-logout during slow testing.
